decisions.reason: As a core office-system extension aligned with flexible workplace trends, this desk system likely has strategic value and enough remaining upside to justify keeping the option open.
A chair family is very close to the firm's core premium seating offer, so after several years it is more likely a portfolio staple than a candidate for withdrawal.
These floor cushions look like a narrower adjacent experiment with limited relevance to the firm's main furniture business, so the option value now seems lower than the benefit of freeing resources.
A soft upholstered sofa fits the firm's established lounge and living positioning well, and designer-led premium sofas typically merit a longer market run.
The high standing table supports evolving office and conference use cases and remains close enough to the core range that keeping it is a reasonable low-regret option.
Because the rug collection is the most distant from the established offer, its strategic fit is weaker and its prospects are now more likely judged insufficient relative to other development options.
